description: Build a message filter that accepts a message only when it has not been accepted during the preceding ten seconds. Example 1: a message at time 1 is accepted and the same message at time 2 is rejected. Example 2: after accepting a message at time 1, another copy at time 11 is accepted. Constraints: calls arrive in nondecreasing timestamp order; timestamps and message text fit ordinary integer and string storage.
intuition: For each message, only the timestamp of its last accepted occurrence matters.

brute_force.approach: Keep all accepted message-time pairs and scan recent history for the requested message.

optimal.approach: Map each message to its last accepted timestamp and update that entry only when the ten-second interval has elapsed.

edge_cases: A repeated message at a time difference of nine seconds is rejected.
A message becomes eligible again at a difference of exactly ten seconds.
